summary: Azul S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its common shares and American depositary shares (ADSs, each representing two common shares) have been approved for listing on NYSE American, with trading expected to commence on June 1, 2026, under ticker AZUL. The ADSs will cease to be quoted on OTC Markets, while common shares continue trading on B3 Brasil. The company plans to uplist to the New York Stock Exchange in early July 2026. This is a voluntary exchange listing, not a special situation reorganization. No deal terms, recommendation, or advisor are involved.
